$description: kylet.se brand tokens: the mark's colours and the theme roles the design doc names (docs/design/README.md, docs/design/tokens.json). site/src/theme.rs implements them and a unit test holds the two together.

ink.$description: the mark's tile; headings and primary text; light theme

ink-dark.$description: headings and primary text; dark theme

paper.$description: the K on the tile, and the wordmark on dark; the ink's partner, and the drawing's white

surface.$description: cards and grouped lists; light theme

surface-dark.$description: cards and grouped lists; dark theme

ember.$description: the dot: the Keel family accent; decoration only, never text

accent.$description: text links and arrows; light theme

accent-dark.$description: text links and arrows; dark theme

text.$description: running text: the reader's own system faces, nothing downloads

display.$description: headlines and the hero name: the system display face, nothing downloads

wordmark.$description: the wordmark only, outlined at weight 620 and never set as live text (SIL OFL 1.1; no font file ships)
